rule: GOAL: Catch the falling piece with the bar. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the bar; SPACE confirms a catch. RULE: The bar cannot reach the piece directly, so it must wait below for the piece to drop into range. TRAP: You may think SPACE moves the bar up to reach the piece, but it only registers a catch from below.

GOAL: Move two pieces into two separate target rooms. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; clicking switches which piece is active. RULE: A piece touching the bar jumps over it to the other side. TRAP: Filling both targets is not enough; every piece must be placed correctly.

ESTABLISHED: A horizontal bar blocks the upper area. The 3x2 piece stays intact when clicked or moved near it. Both pieces are currently stuck at the right edge. FAILED: Clicking the piece to split it. Moving it up against the bar. Repeated downward shifts without changing its state. GOAL IS NOT: Simply fitting the whole 3x2 piece onto the visible outline, as the bar prevents access. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected piece one step. Clicking selects a piece but does not split it.

ESTABLISHED: The special cross moves on all white tiles, and an ordinary cross can rest inside its outline. FAILED: Parking the special cross on the white marker, clicking the gray outline, and selecting the white board itself. GOAL IS NOT: A simple piece-to-marker transfer; the special cross likely acts as a movable boundary or container. CONTROLS: Click a cross to select it, then click an adjacent tile to move. Only the ordinary cross is currently selectable.

ESTABLISHED: The white piece’s first move is valid, and its next placement fits the green board. FAILED: Repeated searches crashed during this second step, blocking any solution. GOAL IS NOT: A path found by the current script, since it never reached the finish. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the piece; space rotates it. Clicks may select it. Keep it on the board.

ESTABLISHED: Touching the gray strip from all four sides does nothing. The green piece does not pull the strip sideways. FAILED: Aligning white edges with the strip’s faces. Moving the green piece laterally while touching it. GOAL IS NOT: A simple side-to-side match. The gray strip may be a movable piece, not just a target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the green piece; it stops at the strip’s edge. Clicking other elements has no visible effect.

ESTABLISHED: Red bars are movable; the ground piece is plain. All delivery alignments have been tested and failed. FAILED: Every possible placement of red bars to support delivery. Inspecting the ground piece for hidden markings. GOAL IS NOT: A simple delivery task solvable by bar alignment alone. The ground piece is not a marked target. CONTROLS: Red bars can be moved. The ground piece has no observed interaction options.

GOAL: Guide the green board to touch the white piece’s blue strip. CONTROLS: Arrows move the board; the board’s red pegs can also serve as contact points. RULE: Contact requires a red peg to align with a blue strip, not just proximity. TRAP: Assuming the board could move freely; edge boundaries blocked several planned approaches, forcing unexpected rotations.
